turns.question: My shot does feel smoother lately though. Have I actually improved?
turns.player_text:

It’s encouraging that the shot feels smoother, too. That’s your experience of the motion; the recordings don’t independently establish that it became smoother or that the knee drill caused the better results. The sets are still small, so we can’t yet call the improvement lasting.

Keep using the shot that feels natural, without the awkward knee cue. Track your makes in a few more free-throw sets; regularly reaching your goal would be a stronger sign the improvement is holding.

turns.question: What should I work on next?
turns.player_text:
Next, work on **recognizing your miss pattern**, rather than changing your form. Your earlier makes and misses didn’t show a clear mechanical difference, and your latest set had too few misses to point to a new correction.

On your next free throws, keep the natural shot that’s feeling smoother. When you miss, notice whether the ball finishes short, long, left or right. If one direction shows up repeatedly, that gives us a useful starting point for what to work on next.
